08_FAQ_Maintenance — keeps 04's FAQ "second heart" clean & ranked

FAQ TAB (Media spreadsheet): question | answer | hit_count | embedding | rank | approved | updated_at
  approved=TRUE only: 04 serves a cached answer only from approved rows. Seed
  rows (this workflow) are approved=true; rows auto-grown by 04 come in as
  approved=false and must be ticked TRUE by a human before they are served.
  04 reads this tab first for every question. A cosine match on the cached
  embedding serves the cached answer with ZERO Gemini CHAT calls -> beats the
  free-tier token/min limit for repeated questions.

PATH A — DAILY RE-RANK + PRUNE (Daily 03:30):
  Read FAQ -> Plan Rank -> Route Plan
    rank   -> Write Rank   (re-number top 20 by hit_count DESC: rank 1..20)
    delete -> Delete Tail  (drop rows ranked > 20, least-asked; DESC ranges)
  => the sheet always holds only the top-20 most-asked Q&A, re-ranked.

PATH B — ONE-TIME MANUAL BACKFILL (Backfill Now):
  Seed FAQ Rows -> Embed Seed (Gemini embedding) -> Build Seed Row -> Upsert Seed
  Seeds the FAQ tab with the project's existing common Q&A so the cache works
  from day one. Edit the list in "Seed FAQ Rows" with your real top questions,
  then run once. Matching is by question (appendOrUpdate) so re-running is safe.

SETUP: create a "FAQ" tab in the Media spreadsheet with the 6 headers above.
  Same Google Sheets + Gemini credentials as 04. Publish to run the daily
  schedule automatically. errorWorkflow = 05_Error_Logs.
